metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a C++20 `iges` CLI in `output/` with all required subcommands and JSON/error contracts:

- `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip`
- 80-column fixed-format IGES read/write (S/G/D/P/T handling, single T-line emit)
- Global-section delimiter/Hollerith parsing, defaults, and validation
- Directory/parameter parsing with DE cross-reference checks
- Canonical diagnostic envelope output on failures
- Schema-driven entity data parsing for the 87-entity catalog in your appendix
- `eval` support for the requested curve/surface classes (with xform application order)

Files created:

- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/src/main.cpp)
- [generated_schema.inc](/workspace/output/src/generated_schema.inc)

Build command succeeds:

```bash
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

I also ran smoke tests (`write -> parse -> query -> eval -> roundtrip`) successfully on a synthetic IGES sample, including second-pass roundtrip byte identity on that sample.
